$comment: Job DQ (DPDP): the companies that process personal data for Stack19, as data. The country is where the service processes or stores the data. First draft: the owner checks each line against the provider's current terms (docs/runbooks/dpdp-owner-checklist.md).

subprocessors.name: Google Cloud
subprocessors.purpose: Runs the app, its background worker and the files you upload
subprocessors.data: Everything the app holds for your business

subprocessors.name: Supabase
subprocessors.data: Your account, your business records and your customers' records

subprocessors.name: Resend
subprocessors.purpose: Sends the e-mails the app sends to you (sign-in links, reminders)
subprocessors.data: Your e-mail address, your name and the text of the e-mail

subprocessors.name: Zoho
subprocessors.purpose: Company mailboxes (the addresses you write to and hear from)
subprocessors.data: What you write to us by e-mail

subprocessors.name: Anthropic
subprocessors.purpose: The AI that drafts replies and answers questions, when you switch it on
subprocessors.data: The words of a question or message and the business facts needed to answer it; no payment details

subprocessors.name: Meta (WhatsApp Business Platform)
subprocessors.purpose: Delivers WhatsApp messages between your business and your customers
subprocessors.data: Customers' phone numbers and the messages

subprocessors.name: Sarvam AI
subprocessors.purpose: Speaks and understands Indian languages on calls and voice notes, when you switch it on
subprocessors.data: The text to be spoken, or a short recording to be understood
